queries.prompt: This README opening is accurate but hard for warehouse staff to follow. Rewrite it in plain English, keeping the file-size limit and the warning that imports cannot be undone.

Review this PR description before I post it. Point out misleading claims and give local fixes; don't rewrite the whole description: ‘This completely eliminates flaky uploads. I tested one interrupted upload locally.’

Draft a customer incident update from this timeline: requests failed from 14:10 to 14:28 UTC, 12% of requests in EU only; we rolled back at 14:28. Whether any queued jobs were lost is still unknown. Keep that uncertainty visible.

Help me write a cover letter for a Go backend role. I have three years of Go at work and one weekend Rust project. The listing accepts either language; please make the strongest honest case from these notes.

Our homepage says ‘The ultimate platform for effortless compliance.’ What can we actually say if the product only exports audit logs as CSV? Give me a headline and two sentences without promising certification.

Turn these changes into release notes: minimum Node version is now 22, the callback API was removed, and uploads can resume after reconnecting. Put the upgrade impact first and don't invent migration commands.
Improve this error message for someone who does not know what a token is: ‘Authorization failed.’ We know the sign-in session expired and the user can sign in again. Keep it to one sentence.
Edit my speaker bio for a database conference. I reviewed a migration plan; I did not lead the migration. Keep that distinction, and keep the bio under 60 words.

Use Ghostwriter to check this already short runbook paragraph. If it is clear and accurate, leave it alone: ‘Select Retry to send the failed batch again. Retry does not resend records marked Complete.’

Make this team announcement less stiff without hiding the change: ‘Effective immediately, all personnel are hereby advised that the build allowance shall be reduced from 10,000 to 6,000 minutes per month.’ The change actually begins November 3, 2026.
The README says the worker uses PostgreSQL, but our integration test deadlocks. Inspect the SQL and fix the locking bug. Leave documentation unchanged.
Implement this parser error exactly as specified: `invalid record: missing id`. Add the validation branch and a unit test; do not revise the message wording.
Extract the installation command from README.md and return it verbatim. Don't edit the file or explain the command.
Run the repository's Markdown formatter and report whether it passes. Do not review or rewrite prose.
Install the Ghostwriter skill with npx skills in this project and show me which files the installer added.
The incident is still happening: use the metrics and deployment logs to find why upload requests return 503. Diagnose the service; no customer update is needed yet.
Convert these strings into a JSON array, preserving every character: ‘world-class infrastructure’, ‘No data was lost’, ‘utilize the dashboard’. Return JSON only.
Calculate 141 divided by 212 as a percentage rounded to two decimal places. Return only the number and percent sign.
Create a GitHub Actions workflow that runs pnpm test on pull requests using Node.js 22. This is a CI configuration task; return the YAML file.
Find every broken relative link and fragment anchor in docs/. Report file and line only; don't judge wording or propose text edits.
